title: fanoutqa: What are the country calling codes of the 5 most populous countries in the world? (258f06111ca64e70)

chat_history.content: What are the country calling codes of the 5 most populous countries in the world?

content.content: Need to answer question: country calling codes of the 5 most populous countries. They are China, India, USA, Indonesia, Pakistan? Wait population ranking: 1 China, 2 India, 3 USA, 4 Indonesia, 5 Pakistan. Country calling codes: China +86, India +91, USA +1, Indonesia +62, Pakistan +92. Provide list. Might also consider Russia? But Russia is 9th. So answer accordingly.

content:
Here are the international telephone (country‑calling) codes for the five most populous countries in the world (as of 2024):

| Rank | Country        | Population (≈ 2024 estimate) | Country Calling Code |
|------|----------------|------------------------------|----------------------|
| 1    | **China**      | ~1.41 billion                | **+86** |
| 2    | **India**      | ~1.40 billion                | **+91** |
| 3    | **United States** | ~332 million              | **+1** |
| 4    | **Indonesia**  | ~275 million                 | **+62** |
| 5    | **Pakistan**   | ~240 million                 | **+92** |

These codes are used when dialing from abroad (e.g., dialing the U.S. from Europe would be `+1 [area code] [local number]`).
